about: Code areas that must each be on some wiki page of this repository: covered by a page's `covers:` or by a file the page cites (tools/docs_check.py check_areas). An area is one immediate child (file or directory) of a pattern's directory. A new area on no page fails the docs check: give it a page, or list it under `exempt` with the reason it never needs one. `backlog` is the gap known when the gate was added (2026-11-12); it only shrinks: when a page covers an area, the check says to remove it here. Report: python3 tools/docs_check.py --areas

exempt.webapp/static: the built output of frontend/ (npm run build:deploy), generated and committed; frontend/ is documented
exempt.webapp/tests: the server's tests; the gates they back are described on docs/process/ci-gates.md
exempt.webapp/README.md: documentation itself, kept next to the code it describes
exempt.frontend/src/pages/404.astro: the not-found page: static text with no behaviour to describe
